user.title: Pair a PC

pairing_code.title: Generate a new pairing code
pairing_code.description:
The previous code (if any) becomes invalid. Enter this one in the app:

## {code}

access_pending.title: Pending requests
access_pending.description: This PC asked for these entities/services. Tick to grant or deny - anything left unticked stays pending.

access_granted.title: Granted access
access_granted.description: Revoke access this PC currently has. Revoking is not the same as denying: a revoked entry can be requested again later, a denied one won't be asked for automatically again.

access_denied.title: Denied requests
access_denied.description: Reopen a denied entry to move it back to pending, so it can be granted.

access_grant_read.title: Grant read access
access_grant_read.description: Let this PC read these entities before it even asks.

access_grant_call.title: Grant a service
access_grant_call.description: Let this PC call a service, optionally restricted to one target entity.

access_discovery.title: Search mode
access_discovery.description: When enabled, the app's entity/service picker can also search all of Home Assistant's names (no values, no states) to help find the right id - not just what is already granted. Off by default.
